page.overview:
What is Gi-Hoveg?

Gi-Hoveg is a fictional cosmic entity created by James Ambuehl for his Lu-Kthu Cycle.

Ambuehl classifies Gi-Hoveg as a Great Old One in "The Advent of Uvhash", and as an Outer God in "The Stalker in the Snows".

Known as the Aether-Anemone, Gi-Hoveg is a giant spherical being with spongy flesh and spikes protruding from its body, as well as numerous eyes set between its spikes. It is the arch rival of Uvhash, the Blood-Mad God of the Void. (: "The Advent of Uvhash")

Nobody knows where Gi-Hoveg dwells, but some believe "he exists everywhere". (: "The Stalker in the Snows")
